dish: falafel sandwich with a fresh banana shake
address: 2301 Stevens Creek Blvd, San Jose, CA 95128
w: A 1966 mid-century drive-in and Guy Fieri 'Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives' icon whose crispy herb-marbled falafel and cult banana shake have kept lines out the door for 50+ years.

dish: Joe's Special and veal parmigiana at the counter
w: The definitive downtown San Jose old-school Italian-American institution, run by the Rocca family since 1956 with clubby booths, tuxedoed servers and pre-Sharks-game Manhattans.

dish: the secret 'orange sauce' on a super burrito
address: 140 E San Carlos St, San Jose, CA 95112
w: The near-SJSU taqueria behind the Bay Area's most obsessed-over condiment; the creamy chile 'orange sauce' (a vegan family secret) is a late-night San Jose legend that spawned a hundred imitators.

dish: eggs Benedict and oversized breakfast plates
w: A San Jose breakfast tradition since 1977, the Willow Glen flagship draws weekend waits for big scrambles, Benedicts and pancakes.
sources: San Jose | Diner classics | Bill's Cafe — https://www.metrosiliconvalley.com/metro/12.19.07/dining-0751.html

Bay Area Bites Guide to 5 Popular Brunch Spots South of San Francisco — https://www.kqed.org/bayareabites/113999/bay-area-bites-guide-to-5-popular-brunch-spots-south-of-san-francisco (verify names Bill's)

address: 143 W Santa Clara St, San Jose, CA 95113
w: Founded in downtown San Jose in 2014 by three cousins all named Nick, this souvlaki-and-gyro house grew from one storefront into a fast-casual phenomenon now franchising across the West.

dish: Portuguese seafood cataplana / arroz de marisco tasting
address: 1614 Alum Rock Ave, San Jose, CA 95116
w: San Jose's first and only Michelin-starred restaurant, an ambitious Portuguese fine-dining room in the Little Portugal district known for its seafood cataplana and deep wine cellar.
sources: kron4.com/news/bay-area/san-joses-only-michelin-star-restaurant-announced-reopen/ — 'Adega: San Jose's only Michelin-star restaurant announced reopen'

dish: made-to-order TCHO chocolate liquid-nitrogen ice cream
address: 3055 Olin Ave, Suite 1055, San Jose, CA 95128
w: Bay-born (Stanford b-school idea, SF wagon start) brand that freezes each scoop to order with liquid nitrogen and a patented 'Brrr' machine; the Santana Row shop puts on the fog-cloud show.
sources: kqed.org/bayareabites/78580 — '(Tasty) Ice Cream and Liquid Nitrogen: Get Smitten with Robyn Sue Fisher'

w: The cult Bay-born, one-cup-at-a-time pour-over chain; this Palo Alto shop was Philz's first location outside San Francisco and the Mint Mojito iced coffee is its signature obsession.
sources: Whimsical forest mural at Philz Coffee (Palo Alto, Forest Ave) getting uprooted — https://www.paloaltoonline.com/news/2017/01/24/whimsical-forest-mural-at-philz-coffee-getting-uprooted/ ; also Best Of Palo Alto winners lists

dish: chicken tikka masala and chicken Memoni samosas
address: 365 S California Ave, Palo Alto, CA 94306
w: A Silicon Valley cult favorite for Pakistani home cooking, the California Ave flagship earned a spot in the Michelin Guide on the strength of its chicken Memoni samosas and buttery tikka masala.

address: 250 S California Ave, Palo Alto, CA 94306
w: Michelin-starred New American from French Laundry alums Anthony Secviar and master sommelier Dennis Kelly; a serene tasting-menu dining room plus a walk-in lounge/bar on California Ave.

dish: housemade sausages and a large German beer list
w: Downtown Mountain View's flagship beer garden and New American gastropub, rescued by a new owner in 2025, known for its patio, house sausages and deep tap list.

dish: 'Destination' lattes (Tokyo, Santiago) and rose pistachio drinks
address: 3985 Stevens Creek Blvd, Santa Clara, CA 95051
w: Silicon Valley-born specialty roaster with a big social-media following for its globally themed 'Destination' lattes and photogenic pastries; the Stevens Creek cafe is the busy flagship.

address: 40 N Santa Cruz Ave, Los Gatos, CA 95030
w: Born from David Kinch's three-Michelin-starred Manresa, James Beard-recognized baker Avery Ruzicka's Los Gatos flagship is famous for its crackly, buttery kouign-amann and levain loaves.

dish: contemporary French prix-fixe with a landmark wine list
w: Saratoga's long-running Michelin-starred (18 consecutive years) fine-dining destination, a Silicon Valley special-occasion landmark with a Wine Spectator Grand Award cellar.

dish: burgers and the secret-recipe deviled eggs
address: 3567 Alameda de las Pulgas, Menlo Park, CA 94025
w: A 1966 West Menlo Park dive institution near Sand Hill Road, the graffiti-carved 'melting pot' of Stanford students, VCs and Little League teams famous for its unchanged secret deviled-egg recipe.
